units.summary: Adds an optional onStatus callback field to the unexported statusRecorder. It does nothing unless set.
units.headline: statusRecorder gains optional onStatus callback field
units.reason: Unexported struct field that is inert until set by serveThroughBreaker.

units.summary: WriteHeader now invokes onStatus with the final status (>=200 or 101) before forwarding the header. This is what lets the breaker outcome be reported at header time.
units.headline: WriteHeader fires onStatus callback when final status written
units.reason: Changes when breaker outcomes are reported, in the proxy hot path.
focus: callback runs before the header is forwarded; it must not block or panic
onStatus can fire on repeated final WriteHeader calls; the caller's once guard handles that

units.summary: Introduces a type alias groupBreaker for the two-step gobreaker breaker, used across router and ST fallback.
units.headline: New groupBreaker alias for two-step gobreaker
units.reason: Type alias only; behavior is driven by the constructor and caller changes.

units.summary: Constructor now builds a TwoStepCircuitBreaker with the same settings and returns the alias type.
units.headline: newGroupBreaker returns two-step breaker
units.reason: Same settings, different breaker API; behavior is in serveThroughBreaker.

units.summary: Replaces cb.Execute with Allow plus a done callback. The outcome is reported once, when the status is written, or on return or panic. This stops a long-lived watch from holding the half-open trial slot.
units.headline: Breaker outcome reported at status write, not handler return
units.reason: Core circuit-breaker control flow, panic handling and outcome timing changed.
focus: once-guarded report across onStatus, normal return and panic paths
panic path re-panics after reporting and synthesizes a failure when the outcome is nil
any Allow error now yields 503, not just open or too-many-requests
a handler that writes without WriteHeader is only reported at return

units.summary: The test helper's parameter type changes to the groupBreaker alias.
units.headline: Test helper takes groupBreaker type
units.reason: Test-only type update.

units.summary: The test now builds a two-step breaker to match the production type.
units.headline: Half-open cap test uses two-step breaker
units.reason: Test-only constructor change, with the assertions unchanged.

units.summary: tripBreaker now trips the breaker through Allow and done(err) instead of Execute.
units.headline: tripBreaker uses Allow/done API
units.reason: Test helper adapted to the two-step API.
